params.name: flight_ids
params.description: Comma-separated FR24 flight IDs (hexadecimal). Maximum 15 IDs. Example: "391fdd79,35f2ffd9"

params.name: event_types
params.description: Comma-separated event types to filter by. Use "all" to return all event types.

items.docs: Returns comprehensive historical information on flight events including takeoff, landing, gate movements, and airspace transitions. Lightweight version includes fr24_id, callsign, hex, and events list.
